headline: Romania is interested in uranium from Niger. Nuclearelectrica wants to buy 300 tonnes, the deal would be worth 40 million dollars
summary: Romanian nuclear company Nuclearelectrica has expressed interest in buying 300 tonnes of uranium concentrate from a stock of over 1,000 tonnes. The deal would be worth about $40 million.
why: Nuclearelectrica operates Romania's nuclear power plants, and uranium supply contracts affect its fuel costs. Uranium is the key fuel input for nuclear power generation.

backfill_provenance.description_from: publisher page metadata, translated to English by Claude
